Class Product

java.lang.Object
stockly.model.Product
public class Product extends Object
Represents a single inventory product.

Each product has a unique identifier, a name, and a stock quantity. The stock status is never stored — it is always derived from the quantity via getStockStatus() so it can never become inconsistent with the actual quantity.

Author:
Tooba Akram and Abeeha Noor

    • DEFAULT_LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD

      public static final int DEFAULT_LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD
      Default low-stock threshold, kept for reference. The live value is AppConfig.getLowStockThreshold() and can be changed in Settings — it applies to every product immediately.

    • getStockStatus

      public StockStatus getStockStatus()
      Derives the stock status from the current quantity.
      • quantity == 0 → StockStatus.OUT_OF_STOCK
      • 1 <= quantity <= AppConfig threshold → StockStatus.LOW_STOCK
      • quantity > AppConfig threshold → StockStatus.IN_STOCK
      Returns:
      the stock status matching the current quantity
